ars_nouveau.augment_desc.glyph_place_flu: Увеличивает радиус области воздействия на выбранные блоки.
Applies silk touch when breaking a Блок.
Applies fortune when breaking a Блок.
Увеличивает глубину области воздействия на выбранные блоки.

ars_nouveau.starbuncle.energy_from: Старбункл will take Энергия from this battery
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.fluid_from: Старбункл will take fluids from this tank
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.gas_from: Старбункл will take gas from this tank
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.miner: Старбункл will mine blocks in this spot
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.place: Старбункл will place blocks in this spot
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.robin_item_behavi: Старбункл will now round-robin items between multiple inventories
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.sided_item_behavi: Старбункл will now insert/extract items from specified sides
ars_nouveau.starbuncle.trashing_items: Trashing items from ground и %d locations
starbunclemania.adv.desc.robin_mask: Acquire a Robin Mask for Старбункл
starbunclemania.adv.desc.wixie_cook: Place a Wixie on a Furnace, a Crucible или a Cooking Pot
starbunclemania.adv.desc.wixie_mixer: Поместите Викси на банку с жидкостью, чтобы создать смеситель Викси
starbunclemania.adv.desc.wixie_stonework: Place a Wixie on a Stonecutter или on a Cutting Board
starbunclemania.adv.title.wyrm_degree: И это ещё благодаря двум моим дипломам...
starbunclemania.balloon.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to transport Mekanism chemical around. Can be Окрашенный и used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior. Supported familiars: Старбункл, Drygmy, Wixie.
starbunclemania.battery.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to transport FE Энергия around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.bucket.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to transport fluids around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.builder_hat.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to place blocks in specified spots. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.chef_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic curio for Players, Starbuncles и Wixie Familiars.
starbunclemania.degree_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic for your familiars. Supported creatures: Starbuncles, Bookwyrm (Familiar). Also allows Предмет starbuncles to read Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_pickup_: Pickups Fluids from world и fill a tank in the hotbar или next to the turret
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_place_f: Place Fluid in world, draining from a tank in the hotbar или next to the turret
starbunclemania.miner_hat.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to mine blocks in specified spots. You can give it a tool to use, defaults to an Железо pick. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.page.direction_scroll: Provides a face/direction to Старбункл automations. When the scroll is used on a Старбункл или placed in an Предмет frame on a Блок, the Старбункл will interact with the Блок from the specified face.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_jar: A tank made from cascading archwood logs that can hold up to 16 buckets of fluid. If used to store a potion fluid и a potion jar is placed above it, the fluid will be converted to the jar for flask/melding use.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_scroll: Provides a Фильтр to Старбункл fluid automations. Works like the Предмет counterpart, used on a Старбункл или placed in an Предмет frame on the tank.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_sourcelink: Consumes fluids to generate Источник. Will automatically drain from tanks below it if compatible.
starbunclemania.page.player_cosmetic: Have you ever wanted to look a bit more like a Старбункл? или have a cool sandy hat, horns или even a propeller? Now you can! These accessories are purely cosmetic и can be worn by players in the Head curio slot.
starbunclemania.page.robin_mask: Allows Starbuncles to round-robin items between inventories. While wearing the accessory, the Старбункл will only pickup items from the ground. Each stacked Старбункл will carry maxStack/numDestInventories items, before moving to the next inventory.
starbunclemania.page.source_condenser: Condense the Источник from Jars into a stable fluid. Will automatically Выход to tanks below it if possible. A specific Источник can be linked to it with the Dominion Жезл, pulling from all nearby jars otherwise.
starbunclemania.page.star_balloon: Allows Starbuncles to transport simple gasses [Mekanism]. Can be Окрашенный if used as cosmetic, but will use the stored gas Цвет when used for transport. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion Жезл to connect them between gas tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_battery: Allows Starbuncles to transport Энергия. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion Жезл to connect them between FE blocks.
starbunclemania.page.star_bin: Allows Starbuncles to embrace their inner raccoon и trash items. While wearing the accessory the Старбункл will void any nearby Предмет on the ground.
starbunclemania.page.star_bucket: Allows Starbuncles to transport fluids. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion Жезл to connect them between tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_hat: Accessories from StarbuncleMania aren't just for the worker starbuncles to enjoy, you can use them on your Старбункл familiar too! This one doesn't do anything, but is surely stylish. Shift-clicking a starby with an accessory will only set it as cosmetic, without setting the job.
starbunclemania.page.star_saddle: Allows Starbuncles to transport players. While wearing the accessory, the Старбункл becomes big enough to be rideable. [Still a bit wip, might be a bit wonky]
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cook: The Wixie can now cook! Place a Wixie on a furnace to allow it to smelt и smoke items, also compatible with a cooking pot [Farmers Delight] и crucibles [EidolonRepraised] to automate them.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cut: Place a Wixie charm on a stonecutter или on a cutting board to have it use their cutting recipes for craftings.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_mixer: Place a Wixie charm on a fluid jar to convert it to a different Тип of cauldron. The Mixer has two internal tanks, for Вода и milk, to avoid using buckets in recipes. Only works for Создание table recipes, will always consume only one unit of the fluid needed.
starbunclemania.page.wyrm_degree: Позволяет Старбункулам вставлять и извлекать предметы с определённой стороны с помощью свитков направления.
starbunclemania.robin_mask.tooltip: Tweaks the Старбункл's Предмет transport to round-robin items between inventories, also stops pickup. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.simple_cosmetic.tooltip: Simple cosmetic for your familiars. Supported familiars: Старбункл, Wixie, Drygmy, Bookwyrm.
starbunclemania.trash_bin.tooltip: Changes a Старбункл's job to void the items it pickups и from linked chests. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cooking_p: Используйте амулет Викси на котле. После этого Викси сможет готовить блюда по рецептам котла.
Используйте амулет Викси на тигле. После этого Викси сможет использовать рецепты тигля из Eidolon.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cutting_b: Используйте амулет Викси на разделочной доске. После этого Викси сможет использовать рецепты разделочной доски.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.mixer.too: Use a Wixie Charm on a Fluid Jar. With this, Wixies will use the milk и Вода in the side tanks for Создание recipes instead of buckets.
Use a Wixie Charm on a Furnace. With this, Wixies will use smelt и smoke recipes.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.stonecutt: Используйте амулет Викси на камнерезе. После этого Викси сможет использовать рецепты камнереза.
